entities.name: Ozox
entities.description: A skeleton noble of Innistrad with eternal unlife, an amalgamation of bones.

entities.name: Jumblebones
entities.description: The skeleton from which Ozox can reassemble himself.

events.summary: When Ozox dies he can reassemble himself from Jumblebones.
events.quote: When Ozox dies, he can reassemble himself from the skeleton known as Jumblebones
